dataset: LRS3 only; verified 30-hour trainval release plus independently verified cropped test mirror
schedule: one epoch linear warmup then cosine decay
loss: author 0.1 CTC + 0.9 attention; original 0.1 label smoothing
batchnorm: frozen running statistics for microbatch 1; affine parameters trainable
augmentation: author random spatial crop 88 and AdaptiveTimeMask(10,25)
selection: lowest validation WER; earlier checkpoint wins ties; include original baseline
test_policy: no test gradients or model selection; evaluate baseline and selected model after selection
prior_test_exposure: Original beam5 model previously evaluated on the entire official test. New split uses identities only; validation partition now used for selection, final partition excluded from all subsequent selection/tuning.
pretraining_history: original checkpoint was pretrained on mixed corpora, including LRS2; new run uses zero LRS2 samples
validation_origin: 20% of recording components in official LRS3 test; remainder reserved for final testing
